title: The Year Social Media Changed the World
narrative: Google+ tries to kill Facebook and fails. Snapchat creates disappearing messages. Instagram hits a million users. The Arab Spring proves social media can topple governments. Occupy Wall Street goes viral. HTML5 kills Flash. The web grows up.
